changes: Redesigned the 3D and G-code previewers with responsive layouts, full-screen viewing, stable loading progress, and controls that no longer cover the model.
Improved G-code inspection with separate layer and move scrubbers, first-move replay, selected-layer isolation, clearer event markers, and mobile-friendly toolpath statistics.
Added direct 3D preview access while preparing a print, and improved camera gestures, object selection feedback, initial framing, and scene-building transitions.
Import FBX models and preserve colours and textures from FBX, OBJ, and glTF files in Model Studio.
Convert imported source colours into configurable filament painting with colour reduction, smoothing, matching previews, and undo support.
Simplify detailed meshes while preserving painted regions, with adjustable detail levels and previews.
View and edit project metadata, attachments, cover images, and other BambuStudio project files without losing them when saving or slicing.
Reuse unchanged slicing results, show clearer multi-plate progress, and report sliced material usage more accurately.
Customize printer build volumes, origins, printable heights, and bed appearance for workspace machine presets.
Control supported printer protection modes, camera resolution, nozzle-rack maintenance, and additional Bambu printer settings.
Use printer-specific print options including automatic calibration modes, timelapse storage, nozzle-offset calibration, and external-spool change assistance.
Preview printer-model mismatches before dispatch and explicitly approve cross-model prints when appropriate.
Keep selected jobs in the print queue after completion and use improved material mapping, printer selection, and dispatch safeguards.
Scan filament barcodes to identify materials, prefill spool details, and expose tracked inventory in Model Studio.
Manage library files, printer storage, filament, and slicing presets with improved bulk selection, sorting, grouping, filtering, and mobile layouts.
Access support and suggestions directly from licensed self-hosted installations, with clearer conversation attribution and unread replies.
Apply for education and community access through the cloud signup flow.
View version-specific release notes from the app footer.
